verdict.rationale: Meta ships dedicated guardrail models. Llama Guard 3 is an 8B safeguard model that classifies both LLM inputs and responses against the MLCommons hazard taxonomy. Prompt Guard flags injection and jailbreak attempts and is documented as a filter to run before each LLM call. Together these cover gating both input and output. Missing for 10: a hosted moderation endpoint or configurable safety settings (both guardrails are self-hosted classifier weights), in-depth integration docs for wiring output gating before actions (evidence is short Hugging Face org-page blurbs), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the guard models work.
